scene lingeriewar1
It’s an interesting feeling — sitting alone in some hotel room while my garden is pruned by the green thumbs of hands I grew up holding.
lines.zh: 这是一种奇妙的感觉——独自坐在某间酒店房间里，而我的花园正被那双我从小牵着长大的手修剪着。

lines.en: She was better than me at almost everything. Still is, most likely. And it’s why I can’t help but admire her even when my instincts tell me to stay away.
lines.zh: 她几乎在所有事情上都比我强。现在多半也还是。正因如此，即便本能叫我离她远点，我还是忍不住欣赏她。

lines.en: She’s sure to cause me problems in doing so. Flowers are like people. They change based on what you feed them. Or the blanket that covers their seedbed. And Niki doesn’t know the type of fertilizer I use.
lines.zh: 她这么做注定会给我惹麻烦。花和人一样。你喂它们什么，它们就变成什么样。盖在苗床上的那层毯子也是如此。而 Niki 并不知道我用的是哪种肥料。

lines.en: But I think she’s earned the right to fuck things up after what I put her through. And I think that trying to stop her now would just make me look even more like what I am.
lines.zh: 但我想，在我让她受了那么多苦之后，她已经赢得了把事情搞砸的权利。而且我觉得，现在试图阻止她，只会让我看起来更像我本来的样子。

lines.en: Guilty. Weak. Confused. Other words I’d pluck from the ground to try and appeal to the side of you that still believes in sympathy or empathy or whichever word would best apply now.
lines.zh: 愧疚。软弱。困惑。以及我会从地里随手摘下的其他词，好去讨好你们心中仍然相信同情、或者共情、或者随便哪个此刻最合适的词的那一面。

lines.en: It’s funny how even my expertise in the garden of words has done little to teach me of the difference between those two things. It’s just hard to understand what you’ve never understood.
lines.zh: 真可笑，就连我在辞藻花园里的专长，也没能教会我这两者之间的区别。你从未理解过的东西，终究很难理解。

lines.en: I just hope that Chika isn’t dying at the hands of jealous weed-killer right now. Or that Maya, who I’ve barely even seen since Niki made her post, isn’t shriveling up as well.
lines.zh: 我只希望 Chika 此刻不要正被嫉妒的除草剂毒害至死。也希望 Maya——自从 Niki 发了那条帖子之后我就几乎没见过她——不要也在枯萎。

lines.en: I want to face them. I do. But how {i}could{/i} I when the woman I’ve gifted my strings to has tied them to this bed in an effort to show me where I really belong?
lines.zh: 我想面对她们。我真的想。可当那个我把自己的提线交了出去的女人，把那些线绑在这张床上、只为让我看清自己真正属于哪里时，我{i}又怎么{/i}能呢？

lines.en: If only she knew I’ve been here all along.
lines.zh: 要是她知道我自始至终都在这里就好了。

lines.en: Maybe then I’d exist outside words in her songs.
lines.zh: 也许那样，我就能在她的歌里存在于词句之外。

lines.en: Excuse me, friends. Please don’t blame this on the butterflies.
lines.zh: 恕我失陪，朋友们。请别把这归咎于蝴蝶。

lines.en: scene lingeriewar2
: Hello?
: {i}Good evening, Akira. How are you doing tonight?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}晚上好，Akira。今晚过得怎么样？{/i}

lines.en: : Better than I was the last time we were here. Why?
lines.zh: : 比上次我们在这儿的时候好些。怎么了？

lines.en: : {i}I’m in heat again and looking to expose my belly to an apex predator.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我又发情了，想把肚皮露给一头顶级掠食者看看。{/i}

lines.en: : I think I saw some lady walking a pitbull outside a few minutes ago. You might be able to catch them if you leave now.
lines.zh: : 我记得几分钟前有位女士在外面遛比特犬。你现在出去的话，也许还追得上。

lines.en: : {i}Don’t just tempt me with a good time. Bring it to me yourself. It seems only fair after I gave myself to you last time, doesn’t it?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别光拿好事来勾我。你自己把它送过来。上一次我都把自己交给你了，这样才算公平，不是吗？{/i}

lines.en: : Nodoka-
lines.zh: : Nodoka——

lines.en: : {i}I’m in room 805. And trust me, you’d hate yourself for missing out on this.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我在 805 房。相信我，错过这次你会恨死自己的。{/i}

lines.en: : Joke’s on you. I hate myself already.
lines.zh: : 你失算了。我已经恨死自己了。

lines.en: : {i}Then just think of how much worse it could get. And how irresponsible it would be to neglect such precious opportunities in a world as strange and infinite as ours.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那就想想还能变得更糟到什么地步。在像我们这个既奇异又无垠的世界里，放过这样宝贵的机会，该有多不负责任。{/i}

lines.en: : What do you have planned this time?
lines.zh: : 这次你又打算搞什么？

lines.en: : {i}As if I’m the type to tell and not show.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我像是那种光说不做的人吗。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’ll be waiting.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我会等你的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And I’ll see you soon.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}很快就会见到你。{/i}

lines.en: scene lingeriewar3
scene black
It seems I’m still not trusting enough to leave this all in dirty hands.
lines.zh: 看来我终究还是不够信任，没法把这一切都交给那双脏手。

lines.en: scene lingeriewar4
: Oh. And just where do you think {i}you’re{/i} going?
lines.zh: : 哦。你以为{i}你{/i}这是要去哪儿？

lines.en: : Out, I thought. Unless I’m still on house arrest. How did your conversation with Chika go?
lines.zh: : 出门啊，我以为。除非我还在被软禁。你跟 Chika 谈得怎么样？

lines.en: : Good because I was able to squeeze it out of her that the two of you are having sex. But also bad because I was able to squeeze it out of her that the two of you are having sex.
lines.zh: : 好，是因为我从她嘴里逼出了你们俩在发生性关系这件事。坏，也是因为我从她嘴里逼出了你们俩在发生性关系这件事。

lines.en: : So that’s Noriko and Chika you’ve confirmed. Anyone else?
lines.zh: : 这么说你已经确认了 Noriko 和 Chika。还有别人吗？

lines.en: : How about you just make me a list and save me the effort of having to make more of them cry?
lines.zh: : 你干脆给我列个单子，省得我还要费劲把更多人弄哭？

lines.en: : And deprive you of the opportunity to lord your status over theirs? That just seems unfair.
lines.zh: : 那岂不是剥夺了你拿自己的地位去压她们一头的机会？这也太不公平了。

lines.en: : You actually love that girl, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你是真的爱那个姑娘，对吧？

lines.en: : Is this a trick question?
lines.zh: : 这是个陷阱题吗？

lines.en: : No. I just think that, if we’re actually going to give this an honest shot, we should...you know, actually be {i}honest{/i} with each other.
lines.zh: : 不是。我只是觉得，如果我们真打算认真试一次，就应该……你知道的，真的对彼此{i}坦诚{/i}一点。

lines.en: : She’s not just some sex-friend. You have actual feelings for her.
lines.zh: : 她不只是个炮友。你对她是有真感情的。

lines.en: : Well, what’d you think was the case with Noriko? That I was just bored and wanted to ruin your life?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得 Noriko 那次算什么？我只是无聊了，想毁了你的人生？

lines.en: : Not exactly. But I was also too busy wanting to cut your head off to really think about it at all. And thinking about it again now makes me want to cut your head off once more. So maybe you {i}should{/i} leave?
lines.zh: : 也不全是。不过我当时光顾着想砍下你的脑袋，根本没心思细想。而现在重新想一遍，又让我想再砍你一次。所以也许你{i}该{/i}走了？

lines.en: : Is this reverse psychology? Are you telling me to leave because you think I’ll overanalyze that and want to stay?
lines.zh: : 这是反向心理吗？你叫我走，是因为你觉得我会过度解读、反而想留下来？

lines.en: : You’re coming back, right? Your student teacher said we were sharing this room.
lines.zh: : 你会回来的，对吧？你那个实习老师说我们俩共住这间房。

lines.en: : She said that? Or you {i}made{/i} her say that?
lines.zh: : 她说的？还是你{i}逼{/i}她说的？

lines.en: : I didn’t do anything. She said it was natural for us to stay in a room together if I was going to get involved in your annual estrogenic genocide.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没干。她说，既然我要参与你一年一度的雌性激素大屠杀，那我们住一间房是很自然的事。

lines.en: : I think she has a crush on you, by the way. Which means I get now why she didn’t want to have a threesome with us.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，我觉得她对你有意思。这下我明白她当初为什么不想跟我们玩三人行了。

lines.en: : Niki, I don’t know what I’m supposed to do right now.
lines.zh: : Niki，我不知道现在该怎么做。

lines.en: scene lingeriewar5
: Like, should I stay or should I go?
lines.zh: : 比如，我该留下还是该走？

lines.en: : Because if you go there will be trouble but if you stay it will be double?
lines.zh: : 因为你走会有麻烦，留下就是双倍麻烦？

lines.en: : What? Uhh...maybe?
lines.zh: : 什么？呃……也许吧？

lines.en: : So you just don’t get pop culture references at all, do you?
lines.zh: : 这么说你是完全听不懂流行文化的梗，是吧？

lines.en: scene lingeriewar6
: Not...my style. And I’m really trying not to fuck things up with you this time, so if you really want me to stay, I will.
lines.zh: : 不……不是我的风格。而且这次我真的很想把跟你之间的事别再搞砸，所以如果你真想让我留下，我就留下。

lines.en: : I don’t want a fucking pet, Akira. I want a friend and a lover. And if I just keep you locked up like the whiny little princess you are, it means this isn’t ever going to go anywhere.
lines.zh: : 我不要一只该死的宠物，Akira。我要的是朋友和爱人。要是我一直把你这个爱抱怨的小公主关起来，那就意味着这事永远不会有进展。

lines.en: : But you don’t trust me when I’m not with you.
lines.zh: : 可我不在你身边的时候，你就是不信任我。

lines.en: : Well, duh. Why the fuck would I? All you ever do is hurt me. And chances are, if I find out what you were about to go do, I’d just get hurt again.
lines.zh: : 那还用说。我他妈凭什么信你？你做的每一件事都在伤我的心。而且我要是知道你刚才准备去干什么，多半只会再被伤一次。

lines.en: scene lingeriewar7
: So, instead, I’m going to take a hot shower and order room service while I watch Gilmore Girls. If you’re still here when I get out, cool. If you’re not, whatever.
lines.zh: : 所以，我打算去洗个热水澡、叫个客房服务，边看《Gilmore Girls》。等我出来你还在这儿，挺好。不在，也随便。

lines.en: : Peace and quiet doesn’t sound bad after three consecutive confrontations with more of your {i}suitors.{/i}
lines.zh: : 在连续跟你的{i}追求者{/i}们对峙了三场之后，清静清静听起来也不坏。

lines.en: : Just don’t stay out too late. It’s a bad look for me if you crash in somebody else’s room instead of mine.
lines.zh: : 只是别在外面待太晚。你要是睡在别人房里而不是我这儿，我面上不好看。

lines.en: : Niki-
lines.zh: : Niki——

lines.en: scene lingeriewar8
: The longer you stand there, the closer I get to changing my mind. Don’t turn me into fucking Mother Gothel, okay?
lines.zh: : 你站得越久，我越可能改主意。别把我变成该死的 Gothel 妈妈，好吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...who?
scene lingeriewar9
: Out.
lines.zh: : 出去。

lines.en: : Yup. I’ll be back in a little while.
lines.zh: : 好。我一会儿就回来。

lines.en: scene black
: So that works on both of them, then.
lines.zh: : 那招对她们俩都管用了，是吧。

lines.en: : Maybe I should try that move more often?...
lines.zh: : 也许我该多用几次这招？……

lines.en: scene lingeriewar10
The door was unlocked once I got up to the room, held open by a shoe wedged between its body and the wall.
lines.zh: 我上楼到了房间，门没锁，被一只卡在门板和墙之间的鞋撑开着。

lines.en: It’s so quiet you could hear a pin drop. But that silence is cut down by the faint sounds of a young girl pulling herself out of bed.
lines.zh: 安静得连一根针掉在地上都听得见。但这份寂静被一个年轻女孩从床上撑起身来的细微声响划破了。

lines.en: If she really wanted what she told me she did, there’d be no reason for that. She’d lie there and tell me to come to her. And I would.
lines.zh: 如果她真想要她说的那样东西，就没理由这么做。她会躺在那儿，叫我过去。而我也会过去。

lines.en: The subsequent footsteps, so light that it seems she’s walking on air, tell me everything else I need to know about why I’m here and what she’s doing. But the specifics don’t matter.
lines.zh: 随后的脚步声轻得像是踩在空气中，已经把我在这里的原因、她在做什么，全都告诉了我。至于细节，并不重要。

lines.en: : Good evening, Akira.
lines.zh: : 晚上好，Akira。

lines.en: It’s the same as always — a quick injection of morphine to keep things {i}less{/i} painful and {i}more{/i} fun.
lines.zh: 一切都和往常一样——快速注射一剂吗啡，好让一切{i}不那么{/i}痛苦、{i}更{/i}有趣一点。

lines.en: scene lingeriewar11
I suddenly do not care, though, because god damn.
lines.zh: 可我突然不在乎了，因为，我的天哪。

lines.en: : Why, hello. I was worried that the presence of your childhood friend would have kept you out of my bed tonight. How delighted I am to see this is not the case.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你好。我还担心你那位青梅竹马在场，会让你今晚不来我的床上呢。看到情况并非如此，我真高兴。

lines.en: : That’s a good look for you and you should just only wear that for the rest of forever.
lines.zh: : 这身很适合你，你干脆以后永远只穿这个吧。

lines.en: : I had a feeling you’d enjoy the color choice. I figured that white might do me some favors in terms of making me seem {i}pure{/i} when nothing else ever has or will.
lines.zh: : 我就知道你会喜欢这个颜色。我想，既然其他一切都从来没让我显得{i}纯洁{/i}、将来也不会，那白色或许能帮我一把。

lines.en: : Cool, yeah. Get on the bed.
lines.zh: : 酷，好。上床吧。

lines.en: scene lingeriewar12
: Ah-ah-ah, not so fast. I’m the one calling the shots here, Aki-kun. And what fun would it be if I were to just spread my legs for you without us playing a little game first?
lines.zh: : 啊——啊——啊，别急。这儿是我说了算，Aki-kun。要是我二话不说就为你把腿张开，连个小游戏都不玩，那还有什么乐趣？

lines.en: : A lot of fun, actually. Come here and I’ll show you.
lines.zh: : 其实会很有趣的。过来，我示范给你看。

lines.en: : You have nothing to show me that I haven’t already seen a thousand times before.
lines.zh: : 你身上没有什么东西是我没看过一千遍的。

lines.en: : But {i}me,{/i} on the other hand? {i}I{/i} do. {i}So{/i} much to show you, in fact, that you may never want to leave this room. But there are some rules, you see.
lines.zh: : 但{i}我{/i}就不一样了？{i}我{/i}有。事实上，我有{i}那么{/i}多东西要给你看，多到你可能永远都不想离开这个房间。不过有几条规矩，你懂的。

lines.en: : Rules?...
: But...you hate rules. Your entire thing so far has been letting me take everything out on you in a way that-
lines.zh: : 可……你讨厌规矩。到目前为止你的套路一直是让我把一切都发泄在你身上，以一种——

lines.en: scene lingeriewar13
: Rule number one — from this point on, you must do as I say. You will sit there like a good boy and not interject.
lines.zh: : 第一条规矩——从现在开始，你必须照我说的做。你就乖乖坐在那儿，不许插话。

lines.en: : You will mostly speak when spoken to unless providing comments of affirmation or encouragement. It’s quite an embarrassing thing, baring yourself like this before a man. Becoming {i}vulnerable.{/i}
lines.zh: : 除了表示肯定或鼓励的话，你基本只能等别人问了才开口。在一个男人面前这样袒露自己，是件相当难为情的事。变得{i}脆弱{/i}。

lines.en: : I...uh...okay...
scene lingeriewar14
: Rule number two — no touching.
lines.zh: : 第二条规矩——不许碰。

lines.en: : I’m not agreeing to that rule.
lines.zh: : 这条规矩我不会答应。

lines.en: : You {i}will{/i} agree or I will put my clothes back on and send you on your way. It’s critical that this rule must be followed, Akira, or things will quickly devolve into chaos.
lines.zh: : 你{i}必须{/i}答应，否则我就把衣服穿回去，送你出门。Akira，这条规矩必须遵守，否则事情很快就会失控。

lines.en: : Chaos can be good.
lines.zh: : 失控也可以是好事。

lines.en: : In some circumstances, yes. But I believe that the true allure of {i}this{/i} particular scenario hinges entirely on temptation itself and not the desired pay-off.
lines.zh: : 在某些情况下是的。但我相信，{i}这个{/i}场景真正的魅力完全在于诱惑本身，而不在于最终到手的回报。

lines.en: : So are you, like...going to strip for me or something? Masturbate? What’s happening?
lines.zh: : 所以你是要……给我跳个脱衣舞什么的？自慰？到底要干嘛？

lines.en: scene lingeriewar15
: And rule number three — you will be a fair and impartial judge. You swear to secrecy and vow that everything that is about to transpire will never be divulged to someone else.
lines.zh: : 第三条规矩——你要做一个公平公正的评委。你要发誓保密，保证接下来发生的一切绝不外传。

lines.en: : Those are two different things.
lines.zh: : 那是两码事。

lines.en: : I figured I’d roll the interpersonal elements into a singular category so as to not overload your brain with information. You’re going to need it from here on out.
lines.zh: : 我想把这些人际方面的要素合并成一条，免得一次性给你脑子塞太多信息。从现在起你用得上它的。

lines.en: : Nodoka, is this another contest? Is someone else coming?
lines.zh: : Nodoka，这又是一场比赛吗？还有别人要来？

lines.en: : Coming? No. Why, they’re already here.
lines.zh: : 要来？不。哎呀，她们已经在这儿了。

lines.en: scene lingeriewar16
: Just beyond this wall lies my greatest work of art yet — a cacophony of {i}desire.{/i} Of lust. But mostly, {i}confusion.{/i}
lines.zh: : 就在这堵墙后面，躺着我至今最伟大的艺术作品——一场{i}欲望{/i}的喧嚣。色欲的喧嚣。但最多的，是{i}困惑{/i}。

lines.en: : It is a living depiction of who we are and {i}when{/i} we are. This most delicate point of our lives, where things are changing so quickly that our premature brains simply can’t keep up.
lines.zh: : 它是一幅活生生的写照，画的是我们是谁、我们处在{i}何时{/i}。这是我们生命中最微妙的时刻，一切都变化得太快，我们那尚未成熟的大脑根本跟不上。

lines.en: : Each and every day, we must fight to {i}become{/i} something. But as we can not predict the future, we find, more often than not, that we’re building our bones out of rotten wood and rusty nails.
lines.zh: : 每一天，我们都必须为{i}成为{/i}某种东西而奋斗。可既然我们无法预知未来，就常常会发现自己正用朽木和锈钉搭建骨骼。

lines.en: : I have taken these thoughts and turned them into something that {i}breathes.{/i} Incessantly squirming beneath the covers of darkness in hope that, one day, the panic will die out.
lines.zh: : 我把这些念头变成了会{i}呼吸{/i}的东西。它在黑暗的被褥下不停蠕动，只盼有一天恐慌会自行熄灭。

lines.en: : And that we may reach a place beyond the reach of God where the voices are quiet, the colors are aplenty, and all the questions we have ever had have already been answered.
lines.zh: : 也盼我们能抵达一个上帝也触及不到的地方，那里声音安静，色彩丰盈，而我们曾有过的所有问题都早已有了答案。

lines.en: : It is at this point that I’d like to welcome our first contestant.
lines.zh: : 那么现在，我想欢迎我们的第一位参赛者。

lines.en: : {i}I said,{/i} it is at this point that I’d like to welcome-
lines.zh: : {i}我说，{/i}那么现在，我想欢迎——

lines.en: scene lingeriewar17
: {i}I heard you! I’m just mentally preparing myself, okay?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我听到了！我只是在做心理建设，好吗？！{/i}
